Repeated wording does not establish one continuous event or identical surrounding circumstances.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "location-background-creator-production-tooling", "box": [ 0.02, 0.02, 0.96, 0.96 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "terminal", "box": [ 0.2148, 0.1282, 0.5336, 0.3968 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "15 JULY 2026", "label_box": [ 0.20679999999999998, 0.531, 0.5496, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "hero", "source": "
**Location:** `creator-production-tooling`

**Frame:** Beside it, a second stored notice, older and from somewhere else entirely.
`15 JULY 2026`. A different repository, a different subject — two design documents and a
plan. The same bracketed word.

**Action:** The category arrives without the subject.

**Caption:**
> IT WAS NOT ABOUT THIS BOOK.
>
> IT HAPPENED SEVEN WEEKS EARLIER, IN A PROJECT ABOUT SOMETHING ELSE.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `CI-REFUSAL`, Event A. This panel exists to close the
reading the page would otherwise invite; see the page notes.
